title: InfernoAuthBungee
body:
**InfernoAuthBungee is a powerful, modern authentication plugin for BungeeCord/Waterfall networks. Built with security and performance in mind, it provides comprehensive player authentication with advanced bot protection, session management, and a sleek user interface.**




**⚡ Advanced Security**
BCrypt Password Hashing - Industry-standard encryption with 12 rounds
Multi-layer Bot Protection - Intelligent antibot system with attack mode detection
CAPTCHA Verification - 5-character verification codes for suspicious connections
IP-based Rate Limiting - Automatic IP blacklisting for spam connections
Login Attempt Limiting - Maximum 3 failed login attempts before kick
Username Validation - Alphanumeric usernames (3-16 characters)


**⚡ Flexible Database Support**
SQLite - Perfect for small-medium servers (no setup required)
MySQL - Enterprise-grade solution for large networks
HikariCP Connection Pool - Optimized database performance
Automatic Table Creation - Zero manual configuration needed

**⚡ Session Management**
Smart Session System - Configurable session duration (default: 15 minutes)
IP-based Sessions - Players auto-login from trusted IPs
Session Restoration - Seamless reconnection experience
Automatic Cleanup - Expired sessions removed every 5 minutes

**⚡ Modern User Experience**
Action Bar Timer - Live countdown with color-coded warnings (green → yellow → red)
Title Animations - Beautiful login/register/captcha screens
Auto-redirect - Seamless transfer to lobby after authentication
Chat Protection - Complete lockdown until authenticated
Clean UI - Auto-clear chat for better visibility


**⚡ Admin Tools (Console Only)**
/auth - View total registered accounts
/auth status - Real-time plugin statistics
/auth info <player> - Detailed player information
/auth force <player> - Force authenticate online player
/auth changepass <player> <password> - Change player password
/auth deleteaccount <player> - Delete player account
/auth unban <IP> - Remove IP from blacklist
/authreload - Reload configuration without restart


**⚡ Performance Features**
Asynchronous Operations - Non-blocking database queries
Memory Cache - Instant username lookup
Connection Pooling - Optimized database connections
Efficient Timers - Minimal server resource usage


Made with ❤️ by Vlsq | Secure your server today!​
